content.text: Creators in restricted markets are not waiting for Stripe to expand its coverage map. They are not petitioning PayPal to reconsider their country risk model. NOWPayments accepts payment in USDT, Bitcoin, Solana, and 300 plus other coins from any buyer with a wallet — no account creation, no identity verification, no geography check. The webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. The download link arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. This is what sovereign commerce infrastructure looks like operating at full capacity from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, or Harare.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The downfall of conventional payment systems in Venezuela has pushed creators to seek solutions that offer real sovereignty over their digital commerce. COREMERCH's infrastructure leverages blockchain technology, providing a decentralized payment method that ensures you retain full ownership and control of your business. By using NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on the Tron network, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10. This infrastructure eliminates dependency on restricted platforms, allowing you to reach a global audience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you need a few essential components: a domain, a Cloudflare account, and a NOWPayments account. Your domain will serve as the online storefront for your digital products. With Cloudflare, you gain access to reliable hosting and advanced security features. Setting up NOWPayments will allow you to accept crypto payments easily. For creators in Venezuela, Binance P2P offers support for local currencies like the Bolívar, enabling you to convert your earnings seamlessly. This setup empowers you to establish a solid foundation for your digital business.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen stack from COREMERCH, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack. Set up your GitHub or Cloudflare Pages to host your site. After that, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Make sure to configure your webhook settings for instant payment confirmation. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your digital files. This streamlined pipeline ensures that payments are processed automatically and products are delivered instantly, enhancing the customer experience.
Every creator deserves sovereignty over their digital commerce.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital store through social media channels and local communities. Ensure your product listings are clear and include pricing in crypto. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will handle the transaction, and a webhook will trigger the delivery of the product to the buyer. Test this process with a small transaction to confirm everything works smoothly. This first transaction will validate your setup and provide you with the confidence to scale your operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, you can look to scale your operations. Consider adding more digital products to your catalog or exploring additional marketing strategies to reach a broader audience. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, which provide you with the tools necessary to enhance and expand your digital commerce stack. Monitor your sales and customer feedback to optimize your offerings and ensure continued growth.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Blockchain technology eliminates the barriers imposed by traditional payment platforms.

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT on the Tron network, which offers low transaction fees and fast settlement times.
How do I set up product delivery?

To set up product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your digital products. After integrating NOWPayments, configure automatic delivery through webhooks to ensure instant access for customers after payment.
Can I track my sales and customer data?
Yes, by using platforms like Supabase or Google Sheets, you can store and track your sales data and customer information securely, ensuring you maintain full ownership of your business metrics.
Is there customer support available after deployment?
Yes, when you purchase any stack from COREMERCH, you receive 30-day support to assist you with any questions or challenges you encounter during the setup and initial operational phase.
What if I need to scale my offerings?
You can easily scale your offerings by adding more products or utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional templates and blueprints designed for growth and expansion.
